# douyinLive runtime component

- Source: https://github.com/jwwsjlm/douyinLive
- Release: v2.0.24, Windows AMD64
- Release asset: `douyinLive-v2.0.24-79453ece4a44-windows-amd64.zip`
- Asset SHA-256: `cc1cc9df433337c62263d7925da77ab17622603bbb554f1c27d3cbe9048cce4f`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The executable runs a loopback-only client endpoint used by the recorder to
receive decoded Douyin live WebSocket events. It uses its bundled local signer
by default; no online signing provider or API key is configured.
